text_en: Then Jesus summoned his twelve disciples and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to cure every disease and every sickness.
text_cn: 耶稣将他的十二门徒叫来，授给他们制伏邪魔的权柄，可以驱逐邪魔，医治各种病症，各种疾苦。

text_en: These are the names of the twelve apostles: first, Simon, also known as Peter, and his brother Andrew; James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;
text_cn: 这是十二宗徒的名字：第一个是称为伯多禄的西满，和他的兄弟安德肋，载伯德的儿子雅各伯和他的弟弟若望，

text_en: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;
text_cn: 斐理伯和巴尔多禄茂，多默和税吏玛窦，阿耳斐的儿子雅各伯和达陡，

text_en: Simon the Cananaean, and Judas Iscariot, the one who betrayed him.
text_cn: 热诚者西满和负卖耶稣的犹达斯依斯加略。

text_en: These twelve Jesus sent out with the following instructions: “Go nowhere among the Gentiles, and enter no town of the Samaritans,
text_cn: 耶稣派遣这十二人，嘱咐他们说：外邦人的路，你们不要走；撒玛黎雅人的城你们不要进，

text_en: but go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
text_cn: 你们宁可往以色列家迷失了的羊那里去。

text_en: As you go, proclaim the good news, ‘The kingdom of heaven has come near.’
text_cn: 你们在路上应宣讲说：天国临近了。

text_en: Cure the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, cast out demons. You received without payment; give without payment.
text_cn: 病人，你们要治好；死人，你们要复活；癞病人，你们要洁净；魔鬼，你们要驱逐；你们白白得来的，也要白白分施。

text_en: Take no gold, or silver, or copper in your belts,
text_cn: 你们不要在腰带里备下金、银、铜钱；

text_en: no bag for your journey, or two tunics, or sandals, or a staff; for laborers deserve their food.
text_cn: 路上不要带口袋，也不要带两件内衣，也不要穿鞋，也不要带棍杖，因为工人自当有他的食物。

text_en: Whatever town or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you leave.
text_cn: 你们不论进了哪一城或哪一村，查问其中谁是当得起的，就住在那里，直到你们离去。

text_en: As you enter the house, greet it.
text_cn: 你们进那一家时，要向它请安。

text_en: If the house is worthy, let your peace come upon it; but if it is not worthy, let your peace return to you.
text_cn: 倘若这一家是堪当的，你们的平安就必降临到这一家；倘若是不堪当的，你们的平安仍归于你们。

text_en: If anyone will not welcome you or listen to your words, shake off the dust from your feet as you leave that house or town.
text_cn: 谁若不接待你们，也不听你们的话，当你们从那一家或那一城出来时，应把尘土由你们的脚上拂去。

text_en: Truly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：在审判的日子，索多玛和哈摩辣地所受的惩罚，比那座城所受的还要轻。

text_en: “See, I am sending you out like sheep into the midst of wolves; so be wise as serpents and innocent as doves.
text_cn: 看，我派遣你们好像羊进入狼群中，所以你们要机警如同蛇，纯朴如同鸽子。

text_en: Beware of them, for they will hand you over to councils and flog you in their synagogues;
text_cn: 你们要提防世人，因为他们要把你们交给公议会，要在他们的会堂里鞭打你们；

text_en: and you will be dragged before governors and kings because of me, as a testimony to them and the Gentiles.
text_cn: 并且你们要为我的缘故，被带到总督和君王前，对他们和外邦人作证。

text_en: When they hand you over, do not worry about how you are to speak or what you are to say; for what you are to say will be given to you at that time;
text_cn: 当人把你们交出时，你们不要思虑：怎么说，或说什么，因为在那时刻，自会赐给你们应说什么。

text_en: for it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.
text_cn: 因为说话的不是你们，而是你们父的圣神在你们内说话。

text_en: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child, and children will rise against parents and have them put to death;
text_cn: 兄弟要将兄弟，父亲要将儿子置于死地，儿女也要起来反对父母，要将他们害死。

text_en: and you will be hated by all because of my name. But the one who endures to the end will be saved.
text_cn: 你们为了我的名字，要为众人所恼恨；唯独坚持到底的，才可得救。

text_en: When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next; for truly I tell you, you will not have gone through all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes.
text_cn: 但是，几时人们在这城迫害你们，你们就逃往另一城去；我实在告诉你们：直到人子来到时，你们还未走完以色列的城邑。

text_en: “A disciple is not above the teacher, nor a slave above the master;
text_cn: 没有徒弟胜过师傅的，也没有仆人胜过他主人的；

text_en: it is enough for the disciple to be like the teacher, and the slave like the master. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more will they malign those of his household!
text_cn: 徒弟能如他的师傅一样，仆人能如他的主人一样，也就够了。若人们称家主为“贝耳则步”，对他的家人更该怎样呢？

text_en: “So have no fear of them; for nothing is covered up that will not be uncovered, and nothing secret that will not become known.
text_cn: 所以，你们不要害怕他们；因为没有遮掩的事，将来不被揭露的；也没有隐藏的事，将来不被知道的。

text_en: What I say to you in the dark, tell in the light; and what you hear whispered, proclaim from the housetops.
text_cn: 我在暗中给你们所说的，你们要在光天化日之下报告出来；你们由耳语所听到的，要在屋顶上张扬出来。

text_en: Do not fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul; rather fear him who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
text_cn: 你们不要害怕那杀害肉身，而不能杀害灵魂的；但更要害怕那能使灵魂和肉身陷于地狱中的。

text_en: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from your Father.
text_cn: 两只麻雀不是卖一个铜钱吗？但若没有你们天父的许可，它们中连一只也不会掉在地上。

text_en: And even the hairs of your head are all counted.
text_cn: 就是你们的头发，也都一一数过了。

text_en: So do not be afraid; you are of more value than many sparrows.
text_cn: 所以，你们不要害怕；你们比许多麻雀还贵重呢！

text_en: “Everyone therefore who acknowledges me before others, I also will acknowledge before my Father in heaven;
text_cn: 凡在人前承认我的，我在我天上的父前也必承认他；

text_en: but whoever denies me before others, I also will deny before my Father in heaven.
text_cn: 但谁若在人前否认我，我在我天上的父前也必否认他。

text_en: “Do not think that I have come to bring peace to the earth; I have not come to bring peace, but a sword.
text_cn: 你们不要以为我来，是为把平安带到地上；我来不是为带平安，而是带刀剑，

text_en: For I have come to set a man against his father,and a daughter against her mother,and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law;
text_cn: 因为我来，是为叫人脱离自己的父亲，女儿脱离自己的母亲，儿媳脱离自己的婆母；

text_en: and one’s foes will be members of one’s own household.
text_cn: 所以，人的仇敌，就是自己的家人。

text_en: Whoever loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and whoever loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me;
text_cn: 谁爱父亲或母亲超过我，不配是我的；谁爱儿子或女儿超过我，不配是我的。

text_en: and whoever does not take up the cross and follow me is not worthy of me.
text_cn: 谁不背起自己的十字架跟随我，不配是我的。

text_en: Those who find their life will lose it, and those who lose their life for my sake will find it.
text_cn: 谁获得自己的性命，必要丧失性命；谁为我的缘故，丧失了自己的性命，必要获得性命。

text_en: “Whoever welcomes you welcomes me, and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me.
text_cn: 谁接纳你们，就是接纳我；谁接纳我，就是接纳那派遣我来的。

text_en: Whoever welcomes a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward; and whoever welcomes a righteous person in the name of a righteous person will receive the reward of the righteous;
text_cn: 谁接纳一位先知，因为他是先知，将领受先知的赏报；谁接纳一位义人，因他是义人，将领受义人的赏报。

text_en: and whoever gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones in the name of a disciple—truly I tell you, none of these will lose their reward.”
text_cn: 谁若只给这些小子中的一个，一杯凉水喝，因他是门徒，我实在告诉你们，他决失不了他的赏报。
